relationships.subject: EphA1
relationships.evidence_quote: knockdown of EphA1 expression levels using adenovirus short hairpin RNA (AAV-shEphA1) revealed an increase in mechanical stimulation withdrawal threshold (PWT) and withdrawal latency (PWL) when EphA1 expression was decreased

key_findings: EphA1 was progressively upregulated in CCI mice and its knockdown raised PWT/PWL and reduced microglia and pro-inflammatory factors.
EphA1 acts through CXCR4/RhoA/ROCK2; inhibiting CXCR4 or RhoA/ROCK2 alleviated EphA1-driven pain.
